before: In an ordered room, a later deletion of a rejected move's words, or of its paragraph mark, was written as a w:moveFrom of the deleting person without range markers, so a save and reopen read it as a new move and wrote it again with range markers.
after: Only a pending move's own deletion is written as w:moveFrom. A later deletion of a decided move's words is a plain w:del, and the change targets read it as struck text, so a save and reopen keep the document.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format does not change. Only how a copy composes and targets an item that a decided move labels changes; every copy of one code version applies the same log the same way, and an ordered room admits only clients of its own code version.
